boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Hobart William Smith Colleges
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Geneva food and supply stops with directly verified evening hours, from downtown pizza counters to late grocery runs.

cards.title: Settle In for an After-Hours Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Weekend diner run on Canandaigua Road
cards.notes: Use the Friday or Saturday window for a sit-down meal after midnight, and confirm holiday hours directly before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A full-service diner with Geneva’s latest verified weekend restaurant hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Denny’s location page lists the Geneva restaurant at 813 Canandaigua Road and hours until 3:00 AM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant hours are 6:00 AM–11:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 6:00 AM–3:00 AM Friday–Saturday; Denny’s advises confirming holiday hours.

cards.title: Order Pizza Near the Lakefront
cards.subtitle: Midnight pizza stop on Exchange Street
cards.notes: Check the live store page before ordering, then choose carryout or delivery based on how far you want to travel from campus.
cards.short_summary: A downtown pizza counter with a currently verified midnight closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Domino’s official Geneva store page identifies the location at 1 Exchange Street and shows it open until 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Domino's Pizza at 1 Exchange St in Geneva
cards.access_notes: The official location page currently shows service until 12:00 AM; recheck the live listing because daily hours can vary.

cards.title: Make a Midnight Hamilton Street Run
cards.subtitle: Everyday fast-food stop west of campus
cards.notes: Use dine-in, carryout, delivery, or the drive-through, and verify the selected service mode before heading west on Hamilton Street.
cards.short_summary: A flexible late-food option whose restaurant and drive-through both run to midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists the restaurant at 481 Hamilton Street and restaurant and drive-through hours of 10:00 AM–12:00 AM every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through hours are currently listed as 10:00 AM–12:00 AM seven days a week.

cards.title: Build a Midnight Snack Run
cards.subtitle: Late grocery stop on Hamilton Street
cards.notes: Go for groceries, packaged snacks, or prepared-food options, but check department hours because counters may close before the main store.
cards.short_summary: A seven-day grocery fallback for late snacks and residence-hall supplies.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Wegmans page lists its Geneva store at 300 Hamilton Street as open from 6:00 AM to midnight seven days a week.
cards.access_notes: The main store is open 6:00 AM–12:00 AM daily; pharmacy and individual department hours are shorter.

cards.title: Restock Before Eleven
cards.subtitle: Late essentials run on Routes 5 and 20
cards.notes: Use this for packaged food and practical supplies before 11 PM; do not assume the deli, pharmacy, or service desk follows store hours.
cards.short_summary: A late general-store run for snacks, toiletries, and forgotten essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: Walmart’s official Geneva store page lists Supercenter #1731 at 990 State Route 5 and 20 and main-store hours of 6:00 AM–11:00 PM daily.
cards.access_notes: The main store is listed as open 6:00 AM–11:00 PM Monday–Sunday; departments and service counters close earlier.

cards.title: Catch the Castle Street Pizza Window
cards.subtitle: Downtown pizza run with an 11 PM listing
cards.notes: Check the ordering page’s displayed daily hours before choosing pickup or delivery, since the live schedule may change by day.
cards.short_summary: A Castle Street pizza option with a live ordering page showing service into late evening.
cards.evidence_claim: Ciccino’s direct online-ordering page identifies its Geneva location at 127 Castle Street and displays current daily hours through 11:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: The live ordering page displays the selected day’s hours; it currently shows 11:00 AM–11:00 PM. Recheck before departure.

cards.title: Grab a Friday-Night Slice
cards.subtitle: Exchange Street pizza until 10 PM on weekends
cards.notes: Plan this for Friday or Saturday, when the official schedule extends an hour later, and place larger orders before the closing rush.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown pizzeria with later Friday and Saturday service.
cards.evidence_claim: Cam’s official Geneva site lists the pizzeria at 476 Exchange Street and hours until 10:00 PM on Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Hours are 11:00 AM–9:00 PM Monday–Thursday, 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Friday–Saturday, and 4:00–9:00 PM Sunday.

cards.title: Take the Pink-Roof Pizza Run
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday stop on Canandaigua Road
cards.notes: Look for the former Pizza Hut building with its bright roof, then choose dine-in, takeout, or delivery before the weekend close.
cards.short_summary: A visually distinctive pizzeria that stays open later on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Salvatore’s official Geneva page lists the restaurant at 812 Canandaigua Road and Friday and Saturday hours through 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open 11:00 AM–9:00 PM Sunday–Thursday and 11:00 AM–10:00 PM Friday–Saturday, according to the location page.

cards.title: Time a Weekend Wood-Fired Dinner
cards.subtitle: Seneca Street kitchen serving until 10 PM
cards.notes: Reserve this run for Friday or Saturday and arrive with enough time for a cooked meal; the restaurant closes earlier on other open nights.
cards.short_summary: A downtown wood-fired kitchen with a documented weekend dining window to 10 PM.
cards.evidence_claim: Forno’s official website places the restaurant at 100 Seneca Street and lists Friday and Saturday service from 5:00 PM to 10:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: Open 5:00–10:00 PM Friday–Saturday, 5:00–9:00 PM Sunday and Wednesday–Thursday, and closed Monday–Tuesday.

cards.title: Use the Eleven-O'Clock Barbecue Window
cards.subtitle: Friday and Saturday food run on Seneca Street
cards.notes: Choose dine-in or takeout and focus the visit on the restaurant menu; confirm hours on the site, which notes when its schedule was updated.
cards.short_summary: A downtown barbecue restaurant with food service listed through 11 PM on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: The Rusty Pig’s official site lists dine-in and takeout at 60 Seneca Street, describes food including barbecue and sandwiches, and posts Friday and Saturday hours until 11:00 PM.
cards.access_notes: The site, marked updated July 4, 2026, lists noon–11:00 PM Friday–Saturday, noon–10:00 PM Monday–Thursday, and Sunday closed.
